subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

An animal that can live in water as well as on land
solution:
TB Solution:

The correct answer is **'Amphibian'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **'Amphibian****'** means** an animal that can live both on land and in water**.​

 -Example: Frogs are **amphibian** animals that can swim in the water and walk on land, and breathe in both scenarios.

So it is clear that 'Amphibian' can be used as a one-word substitute for **'An animal that can live in water as well as on land.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• **Carnivore** means any animal that eats meat.
 
• **Mammal** means an animal of the type that gives birth to live babies, not eggs and feeds its young on milk from its own body.
 
• **Herbivore** means an animal that only eats grass and plants.

 

​Therefore, the correct answer is option 4.
